description: Retrieve full Aphia records by numeric IDs or canonical WoRMS LSIDs in byte-budgeted segments. Resume nextInputOffset as inputOffset using unchanged aphiaIds and options; inputIndex preserves duplicate and missing positions. includeVernaculars (common names) or includeSources (original description, basis of record, and other sources) requires one submitted ID, one of the two per call; resume nextVernacularOffset as vernacularOffset or nextSourceOffset as sourceOffset, repeating the full primary record. sourceUse filters whole use values ignoring case before sourceOffset; populated values are not trimmed. Successful source results report sourceTotalCount before slicing and unfilteredSourceCount only with an effective filter. Optional failure retains the record without source counts; unknown facts remain omitted or null.

aphiaIds.description: Nonempty original AphiaID list, with no total-input ceiling; at most 50 positions fetched per call. Resubmit unchanged with inputOffset, without deduplicating.

anyOf.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

items.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID, decimal string, or canonical urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:<AphiaID>; outputs remain numeric.

includeSources.description: Retrieve the taxon sources, such as its original description and basis of record; requires exactly one submitted ID and cannot combine with includeVernaculars.

includeVernaculars.description: Retrieve common names; requires exactly one submitted ID.

inputOffset.description: Zero-based local position; resubmit unchanged selectors and options.

sourceOffset.description: Zero-based position in the sourceUse-selected list for the singleton ID; repeat unchanged options. Inactive without includeSources.

sourceUse.description: Case-insensitive whole-value source use, such as original description; populated values are not trimmed, blanks omitted. Filters before sourceOffset; inactive without includeSources.

vernacularOffset.description: Zero-based common-name position for the singleton ID; repeat unchanged options. Inactive without includeVernaculars.

name: worms_get_taxon

budgetLimited.description: Whether the byte budget ended this local page early.

deferredCount.description: Number of original ID positions still deferred.

sourceUse.description: Effective source-use filter with its original value; only with includeSources.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_rejected`: HTTP 400/422 rejected the inputs. `upstream_rate_limited`: Upstream rate limit or local queue overflow. `upstream_access_denied`: Keyless upstream denies access. `upstream_unavailable`: Network, server, or HTML failure. `upstream_timeout`: Request or whole-tool deadline expired. `invalid_upstream_response`: Malformed or incompatible upstream response. `response_too_large`: Upstream response exceeds 8 MiB. `vernacular_batch`: Common names requested for multiple submitted IDs. `sources_batch`: Sources requested for multiple submitted IDs. `enrichment_conflict`: Common names and sources requested in one call. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextInputOffset.description: Resume position in the unchanged original aphiaIds; null when consumed.

nextSourceOffset.description: Resume sources for the same singleton record; null when consumed or not requested.

nextVernacularOffset.description: Resume common names for the same singleton record; null when consumed or not requested.

oversizedItem.description: One indivisible scientific item exceeds the target; retained intact with forward progress.

requiredBytes.description: Serialized paired-surface result bytes for an oversized item, excluding transport-added metadata.

results.description: One positional result per processed ID.

anyOf.description: Documented Aphia record; omitted or null scientific facts and flags are unknown.

aphiaId.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

record.description: Full documented taxon record, or null.

requestedAphiaId.description: Positive safe-integer AphiaID; obtain from worms_resolve_taxon.

sourceTotalCount.description: Complete selected source count, before sourceOffset and the byte budget; only after a successful source read.

sources.description: Sources in upstream order, only when requested and successfully retrieved.

items.description: Taxon source record; omitted or null fields are unknown.

use.description: How the source supports the name, such as original description or basis of record; open vocabulary.

unfilteredSourceCount.description: Complete source count before an effective sourceUse filter; only after a successful filtered source read.

vernaculars.description: Common names only when requested and successfully retrieved.

title: Worms Get Taxon
